; Notebook assistant panel. Document-view insertion target for Move firmware 3.29.
; Requires XOVI qt-resource-rebuilder with a hashtable for the current firmware.
AFFECT [[17298303916558156758]]
    TRAVERSE [[254504370080162629]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: assistantPanelLoader
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 1000000
                source: "file:///home/root/smart-remarkable/Settings.qml"
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; The Move's top toolbar has room for one compact settings control in its
; existing spacer. Keep pen/eraser/selection/More coordinates unchanged.
; Four fingers still sends the lassoed question.
AFFECT [[11313888899523275277]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]] > [[6502786168]][.[[5972374]]=[[233745975898428]]] > [[8398044571386570029]]
        LOCATE BEFORE Item
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: assistantSettingsLoader
                Layout.preferredWidth: 50
                Layout.preferredHeight: root.minSize.height - root.gestureMargin
                visible: root.expanded
                source: "file:///home/root/smart-remarkable/AssistantButton.qml"
                onLoaded: item.compact = true
                Connections { target: assistantSettingsLoader.item; function onActivated() { root.closeFoldout() } }
                PenInputBlocker { anchors.fill: parent; enabled: parent.visible; manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT


; The native selection menu sizes and positions Ask alongside Cut/Copy/Delete.
; Keep the selection intact until the client captures it. Reuse the same local
; request latch and busy state as toolbar sends, so repeated taps cannot queue.
AFFECT [[3197972396468700595]]
    TRAVERSE [[6502786168]] > [[12395602925408354507]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
                id: assistantSelectionAsk
                objectName: "assistantSelectionAsk"
                focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                type: tools.type
                text: assistantSelectionRequest.item && assistantSelectionRequest.item.busy ? "..." : "Ask"
                enabled: assistantSelectionRequest.item && assistantSelectionRequest.item.available && !assistantSelectionRequest.item.busy && !assistantSelectionRequest.item.waiting && !assistantSelectionRequest.item.panelOpen
                onClicked: assistantSelectionRequest.item.activate()
                Loader {
                    id: assistantSelectionRequest
                    visible: false
                    source: "file:///home/root/smart-remarkable/AssistantButton.qml"
                    onLoaded: {
                        item.sendSelection = true
                        item.pollWhenHidden = true
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
